checks: Legacy version-1 journal loads all 916 user bytes unchanged
Legacy record migrates to empty game records
Extended settings and records commit atomically
Reload after migration preserves notes, alarms and all settings byte-for-byte
Unchanged settings and records do not write flash
Ordinary settings saves retain game records
Torn write preserves the previous settings and records
Both journal pages rotate repeatedly without losing settings or records
Corrupt latest CRC falls back to the previous valid snapshot
Rejected last slot of a page rotates to the other page in the same save
Save after a rejected slot survives a reload
Rejected middle slot moves to the next slot without erasing
Failing flash reports failure, keeps the last record and erases only once per save
scope: Real ARM storage journal with flash program/erase primitives simulated; physical flash timing and power loss are not verified.
